objectives.statement: Recognize when Norwegian leaves repeated words out because the context already supplies them.
Use det and gjøre det to point back to a previous idea, action, or whole clause.
Produce natural short replies with gjerne, samme her, and det gjør jeg.
Use slik to refer back to a way, manner, pattern, or formulation.

notes: Must teach ellipsis (material omitted but recoverable from context) and anaphoric reference (pronouns and pro-forms such as det, gjøre det, slik pointing back) for tighter, more natural Bokmål. Defer broad discourse cohesion and connectors to discourse_cohesion.
